title: Dualism cannot give a coherent account of reality

statements.text: Dualism postulates two distinct domains and then cannot explain how they relate: how brain processes in one domain cause consciousness in another, or how consciousness, if outside the physical world, could act in it. It ends in epiphenomenalism, which Searle calls absurd.

sources.quote: The real objection to dualism is that we cannot give a coherent account of reality on dualist assumptions.
